note: Twinking hinges on enchants with no level requirement (flagged noLevelReq): they let a level-19 character carry effects far above the bracket's natural power. THE centerpiece is the shoulder slot —  19 gearsets are built around a Requires Level 19 BoE white (common) shoulder carrying a Naxxramas 'of the Scourge' inscription (Might / Power / Fortitude / Resilience of the Scourge, all dropped by Sapphiron in Naxxramas), or a Zandalar Signet inscription from Zul'Gurub reputation. These shoulder inscriptions do NOT soulbind the item they enhance (they behave like leg armor kits / spellthread), so a level-60 applies the enchant to a BoE req-19 white shoulder and mails the finished piece to the twink. The head slot takes a Lesser Arcanum (Constitution / Voracity / Rumination), which also applies to legs; Engineering goggles (Green Tinted Goggles) remain a strong head frame that still takes the arcanum on top. Scourge/Zandalar shoulder values confirmed via Wowhead Classic; other entries still marked 'Verify exact value at authoring' pending per-item confirmation.
